program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # diff-pair L
    "itail": (4e-6, 2e-6, 6e-6),     # tail current
    "i7":    (6e-6, 3e-6, 8e-6),     # 2nd stage current
    "gmidp": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror / M6 gm/Id
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS L (mirror + M6, matched)
    "gmidr": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS ref/tail/sink gm/Id
    "Lr":    (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),        # NMOS ref/tail/sink L
    "fu":    (1.15e6, 0.95e6, 1.6e6),# GBW target -> sets Cc
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9); vdd = 1.8
    It, I7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gp, Lp, gr, Lr = p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], p["gmidr"], p["Lr"]

    # reference diode (sinks IREF)
    mref = lut.size("n", gr, Lr, iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", gr, Lr, iref, vds=mref.vgs)

    # diff pair: solve source voltage with body effect
    vs = 0.3
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=max(vx - vs, 0.2), vsb=vs)

    # second stage: M6 matched to M3 (same gm/Id, L) -> W ratio = I7/(It/2)
    m6 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, I7, vds=0.9)
    W6 = m3.W * I7 / (It / 2)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gr, Lr, I7, vds=0.9)
    W7 = mref.W * I7 / iref

    # cascoded tail: bottom mirrors ref, cascode gate = ibias node (ref diode + R)
    vnt = max(0.08, min(0.15, 0.45 * vs))
    mtb = lut.size("n", gr, Lr, It, vds=vnt)
    Wtb = mref.W * It / iref
    mtc = lut.size("n", 16, 0.5, It, vds=max(vs - vnt, 0.1), vsb=vnt)
    R = (vnt + mtc.vgs - mref.vgs) / iref
    R = max(R, 100.0)

    # compensation
    Cc = m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["fu"])
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "vbn", R)
    n.dev("MREF", "vbn", "vbn", "vss", "vss", mref)
    # tail
    n.M("MTB", "nt", "vbn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wtb, Lr)
    n.dev("MTC", "tail", "ibias", "nt", "vss", mtc)
    # diff pair (vinp drives output-side node x -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # mirror load, diode on M2 side
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.M("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W6, Lp)
    n.M("M7", "vout", "vbn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W7, Lr)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "x", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (Cc * cl + C1 * (Cc + cl)))
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e12
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror))
    Rtail = (mtc.gm / mtc.gds) / mtb.gds
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm * Rtail
    psrr = A0 * (m6.gds + m7.gds) / m6.gds
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    sth = 2 * kT4 * (2.0 / 3.0) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)
    cox = 8.5e-3
    W1m, L1m = m1.W * 1e-6, m1.L * 1e-6
    Wpm, Lpm = m3.W * 1e-6, m3.L * 1e-6
    sfl = 2 * 1e-24 / (cox * W1m * L1m * 1e3) \
        + 2 * 5e-25 / (cox * Wpm * Lpm * 1e3) * (m3.gm / m1.gm) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(sth + sfl)
    swing = vdd - 2.0 / max(gp, 1) * 0.5 - 2.0 / max(gr, 1) * 0.5 - 0.05

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "psrr_db": db(psrr), "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller OTA (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc) with cascoded NMOS tail
